purpose: Separate the classifier-scoping share of the structural residue from the share that survives every defensible scoping. The surviving share is the diagnosis queue; the rest is a rule that fires wider than its own stated semantics.
warning: Reordering or rescoping a rule that emits UNATTRIBUTED will always reduce the unattributed count. These counterfactuals are evidence for a decision that must be pre-registered against a new source freeze, never a repair applied to a registered contract in place.
